authority_note_zh: 本协议是开放城市设计提案中的运行机制，不是道路交通法规、政府许可、自动驾驶运营许可或工程控制条件。官方红线和法定控制缺失时，所有空间落位均为 provisional。
core_rule: T0 constant rights override every scheduled or AI-generated request. T3 event operations require named human confirmation. Every machine operation must have stop, rollback, logging and a non-AI fallback path.

conflict_rules.reason: Lower-priority use cannot displace an active higher-priority right.
Accessible continuity is a constant right.
Event layer requires explicit human accountability.
Essential public access cannot depend on an app or AI service.
AI may recommend but cannot replace the required responsible role.
